title: Fix IRS Forms statement filters for box codes containing parentheses
summary: IRS Forms statement filters now handle box codes with parentheses correctly by treating form-box identifiers as literal values instead of filter syntax.
key_points: Added SetFormBoxFilter method to build literal filters using SetRange instead of text interpolation
Updated upgrade and setup statement creation to use the new setter method
Preserves existing metadata, insertion behavior, and upgrade guards
Resolves statement creation and data upgrade failures caused by parentheses in box codes
Added regression test covering parentheses in form-box codes
quote: Programmatically generated filters should treat the form-box identifier as a literal value rather than filter syntax.
